{{Quote|I think those are Merr-Sonn Verqs. Powerful, but their effective range isn't anywhere near three hundred meters.|Jagged Fel|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
The '''Verq''' was a model of close-assault [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]]. Verqs were powerful weapons with short barrels but had a standard range well below three hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. In [[45 ABY]], several [[Nargon]] [[biot]]s serving the corporation [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] on the [[Space station/Legends|installation]] [[Brink Station]] wielded Verqs in a [[Skirmish at Red Ronto|shootout]] with the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] Solo. A recording of the fight was played for Organa Solo's brother, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], at the [[Jedi Academy (Shedu Maad)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Shedu Maad]]; the combat instructor [[Jagged Fel]] observed that the the Nargons had operated the Verqs very proficiently.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Verq blaster rifles appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
